title: MyJKKN Principal Development Engine
paradigm: Quest-driven, capability-based, agency-measured — NOT traditional LMS

phases.name: Plumbing
phases.theme: Build the infrastructure that both LMS and PDE need

features.name: Assessment Engine
features.description: Flexible assessments: quizzes (Phase 1) + demonstration gates (Phase 2). Auto-generate from 2,746 existing lessons.

features.name: Engagement Tracking
features.description: Event logging, daily aggregation, engagement score, at-risk detection. Tracks AI usage patterns for Agency Index.

features.name: Progress Wiring
features.description: Connect existing markLessonComplete/startLesson to lesson viewer UI

features.name: Certificate System
features.description: PDF with JKKN branding + QR code + Fink's radar + Agency Index. Public verification page.

phases.name: The Paradigm Shift
phases.theme: Transform from content consumption to quest-driven capability building

features.name: Quest Board
features.description: Real problems from 44 Solutions Departments, JICATE, NIF, industry. Learners choose what to build.

features.name: Capability Tree
features.description: Visual non-linear skill map. 120+ capabilities derived from 2,746 lessons. Learn what your quest needs.

features.name: Build Arena
features.description: Workspace for building quest solutions. AI interaction tracking for Agency Index.

features.name: Demonstration Gates
features.description: Prove capability through action: peer + AI + faculty triangulated evaluation.
features.note: Uses F1.1 assessment engine with demonstration type

features.name: Community Channels
features.description: Real-time per-quest and per-capability channels. Show-and-tell, help requests, peer collaboration.

features.name: Reputation + Badges
features.description: Points, levels (Apprentice→Mentor), badges, leaderboard. Quest completion + social contribution.

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Quest available, capability unlocked, demonstration result, streak milestone, badge earned, at-risk alert.

phases.name: Intelligence Layer
phases.theme: AI Coach, Agency Index, faculty impact dashboards, MATLAB Grader

features.name: AI Coach (Gemini)
features.description: Coaches, not tutors. Asks questions, challenges assumptions. Adapts style to Agency level. Tamil support.
pages: embedded in Build Arena + lesson viewer

features.name: Agency Index
features.description: 5-dimension measure: initiative, self-direction, tool mastery, critical evaluation, ethical judgment. CASE graduation requirement.

features.name: Faculty Impact Dashboard
features.description: Quest progress, capability heatmap, agency trends, at-risk alerts, Fink's radar, impact board.

features.name: MATLAB Grader LTI
features.description: LTI 1.3 integration with campus-wide MATLAB Grader for auto-grading code.

features.name: Public Portfolio
features.description: Auto-generated from quests + demonstrations. Shareable URL for recruiters.

features.name: NAAC Evidence Reports
features.description: Auto-generated OBE attainment, engagement, competency evidence from PDE data.

summary.existing_foundation: 93 courses, 2746 lessons, enrollment + progress schema, 43 source files
summary.paradigm_shift: Phase 2 transforms from content consumption to quest-driven capability building
unique_differentiators: Quest Board with real problems from 44 Solutions Departments
Capability Tree: non-linear skill map (not sequential lessons)
Demonstration Gates: prove through action, not MCQ recall
AI Coach: asks questions, doesn't give answers
Solutions Hub pipeline: school project → startup
